entries.en:
Eorzea bakes under the sun like an egg over a hot flame, and during such times it falls upon the Adventurers' Guild to offer the realm succor through merriment in the form of the Moonfire Faire. Mayaru Moyaru informs you that in addition to the acclaimed Eorzean Nimble Warrior course, the festivities are being guarded by a brave hero called the Sunshine Savior. However, there are always more hands needed at Costa del Sol, and he encourages you to report to Haermaga if the spirit of volunteering stirs within you.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.

entries.en: As a fellow member of the guild, Haermaga welcomes you with open arms. He asks for your help in solving a pressing issue with the fledgling Sunshine Savior. The chaperone explains that a young man named Lyonell was recruited for the role, but his spirits took a turn for the worse after he arrived in Costa del Sol. Haermaga seems to think a bit of guidance will bolster his confidence, and you agree to offer what aid you can. The young man is standing by near the aetheryte, and Haermaga asks you to follow him there to make introductions.
entries.fr: Haermaga vous a expliqué que le Héros de la Mort qu'ils avaient engagé, un dénommé Lyonell, n'était pas tout à fait à la hauteur de la tâche à cause de son inexpérience. Allez faire sa con<->nais<->san<->ce en reparlant à Haermaga près de l'éthérite de Costa del Sol.
entries.ja: ヒーロー士とは、紅蓮祭期間中にビーチを見守る者のことだった。しかしヘールマガは、その役を担う人物に不安があるという。「紅蓮祭実行委員長ヘールマガ」と再度話そう。

entries.en: The future guardian of Costa del Sol makes an awkward first impression, revealing that the source of his distress is an aversion to having his face exposed to prying eyes. Haermaga does not skip a beat, however, and seems to have a potential solution to the problem at the ready. He asks Lyonell to follow him to a nearby storehouse and asks that you await their return on the shores of the beach.
entries.fr: Après avoir rencontré Lyonell, il vous a ef<->fec<->ti<->ve<->ment semblé peu probable qu'un individu aussi poltron puisse remplir le rôle de Héros de la Mort... Toutefois, Haermaga semble avoir une idée qui pourrait lui redonner du tonus. Allez attendre vos deux compères sur la plage.
entries.ja: ヒーロー士の役を任されていたのは、素顔だとてんでダメな若手冒険者「リオネル」だった。ヘールマガには、そんな彼の弱点を補うための策があるようだ。リオネルとヘールマガが戻るまで「指定地点」で待機しよう。

entries.en: The pair arrive to meet you with Lyonell bedecked in a garish costume, the design of which was apparently commissioned by Haermaga himself─a design understandably met with much scorn by his fellow chaperones. Regardless of the outfit's tastefulness, it seems to have restored Lyonell's confidence, and the young man stands ready to protect the Moonfire Faire's revelers.
entries.fr: En les voyant revenir, vous avez im<->mé<->dia<->te<->ment remarqué que Lyonell n'était plus du tout le même homme. En effet, Haermaga lui a offert un costume spé<->cia<->le<->ment con<->fec<->tion<->né pour l'occasion par la guilde des couturiers. Grâce à ce dernier, Lyonell peut enfin cacher son visage et mettre sa timidité maladive au placard. Parlez-lui.
entries.ja: ヘールマガの策とは、顔の隠れる特製スーツを贈ることだった。新たな衣装に着替えた「リオネル」に話しかけよう。

entries.en: Lyonell's spirits are in high supply, and he is eager to prove himself worthy of the title of Sunshine Savior. However, he acknowledges that he yet has much to learn, and asks that you assist him until he can stand on his own two feet as the beach's protector. If the events of previous Moonfire Faires are any indicator, it will not be long until he is tested.
entries.fr: Maintenant qu'il a retrouvé toute sa confiance en lui, Lyonell est prêt à endosser définitivement son rôle de Héros de la Mort. Continuez de le soutenir<nbsp>!

entries.en: Much obliged. You see, the faire's been no stranger to difficulties, make no mistake. People swimming where they shouldn't be, monsters treating the beaches like a bloody banquet, and all manner of other perils have put a damper on what's meant to be a time for celebration.

そんなところに、ある若手冒険者が立候補してくれたもんで、
任せてみようって話になったんだが……。

entries.en: I'm overjoyed that you think so! Mark my words, the sands of Costa del Sol shall remain safe under the watchful eyes of the Sunshine Savior!
entries.fr: M-merci beaucoup<nbsp>! Faites-moi confiance, le Héros de la Mort va protéger la veuve et l'orphelin sur les plages comme personne<nbsp>!

ああ、ありがとう！
これでようやく、浜辺を見守るヒーロー士として活動できるぜ！

entries.en: Really? I'm quite taken with it─I'm particularly fond of the avian motif. With this, festival-goers can rest assured that they shall be safe under the watchful eyes of the Sunshine Savior!
entries.fr: V-vraiment<nbsp>? Ça a de l'allure pourtant, non<nbsp>? Quoique, j'avoue que ces... “plumes” dans le bas du dos ne sont pas forcément du meilleur goût... Mais peu importe les détails<nbsp>! Tout ce qui compte, c'est que je vais pouvoir remplir mon rôle de Héros de la Mort comme il se doit<nbsp>!

entries.en: Ah, the Go Go Posing Rangers, I know their story well! Those dauntless heroes pitted themselves against the Bombards for the safety of the realm!
entries.fr: Moi aussi, j'en ai beaucoup entendu parler<nbsp>! Notre ami<if(gnum4,e,)> a tout de même un peu raison<nbsp>: les bombattants étaient plus ou moins les Héros de la Mort de leur saison<nbsp>! Sans eux, Costa del Sol serait peut-être aujourd'hui encore sous la domination des ignobles bombardos<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
俺も知ってるぜ、「火消しの戦士」！
防災のために大炎獣ボンバードと戦った、常夏の英雄だ。

entries.en: And just as the flames of the Bombards were extinguished, the Rangers disappeared like a ship over the horizon. Hearing how they risked life and limb with no expectation of reward or fame is what inspired me to join the guild!
entries.fr: Aussitôt leur mission accomplie, ils sont retournés dans l'ombre sans exiger qu'on les couvre d'honneur et de récompenses... Ça, c'est ce que j'appelle de vrais héros<nbsp>! Rien ne me ferait plus plaisir que d'être considéré comme leur héritier<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
ボンバードが出なくなり、彼らも姿を消したが……
報酬も称賛もいらないって言って戦った熱い漢気は、
俺がきっちり受け継がせてもらおうと思ってるぜ！

entries.en: Now then, Lyonell, consider this your official appointment as the Sunshine Savior. Go forth, and remember that you carry the reputation of the Adventurers' Guild on your shoulders. Don't crumble under the weight, lad.
entries.fr: Sur ces belles paroles, Lyonell, tu vas me faire le plaisir de te rendre à ton poste sur-le-champ<nbsp>! Crois-moi, c'est une autre paire de manches que de jouer les hommes-sandwichs pour le compte de la guilde des aventuriers<nbsp>!

entries.en: I admit a part of me is scared almost all of the time, but I can't let that dictate my life and my duty. Whatever happens, I swear to do all in my power to make this Moonfire Faire the safest yet!

Maintenant que j'ai repris confiance grâce à ce costume, je vais faire mon maximum pour que nos festivaliers gardent le sourire en permanence<nbsp>!
